entities.description: Triggers when HPU discharge pressure drops below 150 bar. Panel indication: RED. If persistent > 10s, requires Shutdown Procedure 4.7.
entities.notes: Evaluated against active sensor (PS-04 pre-3.2, PS-04A post-3.2 per ECN-1058).

entities.description: Triggers when HPU discharge pressure exceeds 220 bar. Panel indication: AMBER. Requires stopping HPU immediately.
entities.notes: Possible causes: relief valve fault or setpoint misconfiguration.

entities.canonical_name: Alarm A19: Pressure Sensor Signal Invalid
entities.description: Triggers when pressure sensor signal is out of bounds or drifting. Panel indication: RED. Requires sensor replacement.
entities.notes: Historical cause on PS-04 was sensor drift after 18 months, remedied by PS-04A.

entities.description: Secondary reservoir that tops up main reservoir during peak press demand on Line 4/5.
entities.notes: Line 4/5-specific configuration detail not covered in standard Operator Manual; introduced in training deck and hydraulic schematic.

entities.description: Steps incoming 480V power down to 120V for control circuits.
Supervises startup sequencing, pressure regulation, alarm monitoring, and safety interlocks.
entities.notes: Resetting blocked in firmware above 50 bar to prevent uncommanded valve transition.

entities.description: Primary hydraulic pressure source for the press circuit. Supplies pressurized fluid under supervision of PLC-03.
entities.notes: Standard documentation uses 'Hydraulic Power Unit', while maintenance and training informal materials use 'HP unit' or 'Hydraulic Power Pack'.

entities.description: Isolates the HPU from the press circuit. Must be OPEN prior to HPU startup.
entities.notes: Supervised by PLC-03. Solenoid driven via 24VDC driver output.

entities.description: Incoming 480V electrical main power disconnect switch.
Primary hydraulic fluid storage tank equipped with sight glass level indicator.
entities.notes: Fluid level must be in normal band prior to HPU startup.

entities.description: The hydraulic actuator and valve circuit driving the press operation.
entities.notes: Supplied by HPU via isolation valve IV-21.

entities.description: Original HPU discharge pressure transducer used on software revisions prior to 3.2. Operating setpoint 180 bar.
entities.notes: Superseded by PS-04A per ECN-1042 due to signal drift after ~18 months continuous operation triggering nuisance A19 alarms. Must NOT be merged with PS-04A or PS-40.

entities.description: Updated HPU discharge pressure transducer active on software revision 3.2 and later. Operating setpoint 200 bar, 4-20mA loop.
entities.notes: Introduced by ECN-1042. Requires firmware >= 3.2. Physical label on device reads 'P.S. 04-A' as confirmed on Diagnostics screen.

entities.description: Pressure sensor dedicated to the auxiliary coolant loop on Skid B. Completely unrelated to the HPU discharge circuit.
entities.notes: CRITICAL DISAMBIGUATION: PS-40 shares a numerical prefix with PS-04 but is situated in a different loop on a different skid. Never merge with PS-04 or PS-04A.

entities.description: Wiring terminal block interfacing the 4-20mA pressure transducer loop to PLC-03.
entities.notes: Corresponds to PS-04A signal loop wiring designation in AEG-DWG-W03.

conflicting_facts.applicability: Software revision 3.2 and later (units manufactured after 2024)

conflicts.resolution_rationale: The 180 bar and 200 bar specifications are version-scoped, not mutually exclusive errors. Per ECN-1042 and Operator Manual Rev 4, 180 bar was the standard setpoint for software revisions < 3.2. Effective software revision 3.2, the setpoint was increased to 200 bar to improve cycle times. The 175 bar reading in site_survey_notes.docx represents an unverified field observation on an uncalibrated local gauge, and does not alter the official engineering setpoint.

conflicts.topic: HPU Discharge Pressure Sensor Active Model
conflicts.resolution_rationale: ECN-1042 explicitly supersedes PS-04 with PS-04A for all units at software revision 3.2 or later. PS-04 remains installed only on units running legacy firmware.

conflicting_facts.value: Evaluated against whichever sensor is active for installed revision (PS-04 or PS-04A)

conflicts.resolution_rationale: ECN-1058 issued a documentation correction establishing that Alarm A17's condition evaluates against the active sensor (PS-04 pre-3.2, PS-04A post-3.2). The low-pressure threshold itself remains constant at 150 bar.

conflicts.topic: Hydraulic Schematic Line Anomaly: PLC-03 to HPU

conflicting_facts.value: Grey line (Hydraulic fluid path) connects PLC-03 to HPU
Purple lines (Control/signal connections) connect PLC-03 to PS-04A and IV-21

conflicts.resolution_rationale: The purple signal lines between PLC-03 and PS-04A/IV-21 are structurally confirmed. The grey line connecting PLC-03 to HPU contradicts hydraulic design principles (electronic controllers do not carry fluid). Status is explicitly preserved as UNCERTAIN_EDGE_FLAGGED_FOR_REVIEW for manual engineering inspection.
